queries: Tesla Model Y rear touchscreen 8 inch rear display controls official Tesla 2026
turns.answer:
The Tesla Model Y rear-seat screen is a touchscreen located on the back of the center console, facing the rear passengers.

On the refreshed Model Y (2025–2026), the factory rear screen is approximately 8 inches and supports:

Entertainment: Watch videos and play supported games.

Climate control: Adjust rear-seat temperature and airflow.

Seat heating: Control rear heated seats where equipped.

Front passenger seat adjustment: Move the front passenger seat using rear controls.

Older Model Y vehicles generally do not have this factory rear touchscreen, but aftermarket screens are available.

One important detail: not every 2026 Model Y has a rear screen. Tesla lists it on Premium and Performance trims, but not on the base versions.
